title: Copper Sunset — Confirmed Standalone Middle Painting
approval: Carl confirmed this original standalone middle candidate after rejecting the later triptych crop. Identifying features are the large lower-left rock, four staggered green stalks, a tall copper-red centre with leaves, sunset over water and the village on the right. Deploy this exact painting only.
originalRetention: The untouched full-resolution PNG is retained in the approval conversation and accompanying archive. The repository contains the optimized approved artwork and this provenance, not the full-resolution PNG.

The standard face-fit helper changes only the image box from the shared study box to 0,0,300,400 with zero extra bleed. Only standard rounded corners (radius 26) are clipped.
